g.text: Microduck: separating linear and angular tracking reward weights
Each policy: 2,000 additional PPO updates from one shared initial checkpoint
Weight pairs: (linear, angular). Default and Both reuse the preceding study; Linear only and Angular only are new.
Dots and error bars: 3 evaluation-seed means and sample standard deviation, not confidence intervals.
No-push commands: 10 seconds. Push condition: 15 seconds with separate evaluation seeds. No hardware testing.
